notes: Trusted upstream sources (draft §23). This file answers three questions and nothing else:
which host may be contacted, what artifact a (capability, version) maps to, and where the
It deliberately does NOT contain digests. A digest written next to a download and never
checked against anything is decoration; the only acceptable source of an expected digest is
a published checksum file, and that is what `checksum` points at (draft §23.3-1).
`provenance` and `integrity` are separate on purpose (§4.4:368). v1 does no signature
verification: `signature` stays null, and a digest is never described as a signature.
Growth path: only hosts and capabilities that were actually verified end up here. An entry
that has never been resolved successfully must not be added 'for completeness'.
